pista.noMostrarA11y: Don't show more tips on any screen

termino.hint: Tap to see what it means

perfil.glosarioDetalle: XP, streak, ranks and the rest of the game's words.
perfil.pistasDetalle: Short tips the first time you see something. Turning them on also brings back the ones you closed.

misiones.definicion: What you set out to do on a given day. Complete one and you earn XP; leave it undone and you lose some.
misiones.detalle: Extra missions are separate: they give no XP and don't count for your streak. They give Bonus Points.

dificultad.definicion: How hard a mission is: trivial, easy, medium, hard or epic. The harder it is, the more XP it gives and the more it costs to miss.

evidencia.definicion: A photo taken on the spot that shows you did the mission. It gives 25% more XP, and some missions require it.

cierre.definicion: At midnight the system closes the day. It adds to your streak if you delivered and charges for what was left undone.

racha.definicion: The days in a row you deliver. A day counts if you leave at most 30% of what was scheduled undone.
racha.detalle: Every 7 days of streak, your missions give 10% more XP, up to 50% more. If you miss too much in a day, the streak goes back to zero.

penalizacion.definicion: What you lose at day close for what you didn't do: half the XP of each mission, up to 150 XP a day. The next day you get a mission to win it back.
penalizacion.detalle: The recovery mission returns exactly what you lost, but only that day, and it unlocks once you complete a normal mission. If you break your streak several days running, nothing is charged from the fourth day on.

piedras.definicion: They save your streak and spare you the mission penalty on a day you fall short. You can hold up to 3.
piedras.detalle: You earn one every 7 days in a row with every mission done. It's spent automatically when a day would break your streak. It doesn't cover contract rules.

pausa.definicion: Stops the system when you need it, from Profile. While it lasts, your streak doesn't move and nothing is charged.

xp.definicion: Points you earn by completing your missions and logging what you do. They take you up in level.
xp.detalle: The harder a mission, the more it gives: trivial 10, easy 25, medium 50, hard 100 and epic 250.

nivel.definicion: How far you've come overall. You go up by collecting XP, and each level costs more than the last.
nivel.detalle: If a penalty takes XP away, your level can drop. Your rank can't.

rango.definicion: Your standing in the arena, from E, where you start, to S, the highest. Once earned, it's never lost.
rango.detalle: Moving up takes both level and active days. XP alone isn't enough.

stats.definicion: Five measures of where you're improving: strength, vitality, intelligence, agility and perception. Each mission trains one.
stats.detalle: Every 100 XP earned in an attribute adds 1 point.

FUE.definicion: The exercise attribute. It grows with the gym, cardio and training missions.

VIT.definicion: The health attribute. It grows with good sleep, good food and looking after your body.

INT.definicion: The mental work attribute. It grows with studying, reading and focusing on hard things.

AGI.definicion: The consistency attribute. It grows with the small routines you repeat day after day.

PER.definicion: The reflection attribute. It grows with your journal and with reviewing how things are going.

forja.definicion: A habit you're still building. The system counts its days in a row, only the ones it was due, up to 21.

adquirido.definicion: A habit you've kept for 21 days in a row and now consider done. It's no longer asked of you and can't break your streak, and you earn 100 XP once.

contrato.definicion: Your signed rules: what you commit to every day. Each rule has its own consequence if you break it.
contrato.detalle: A rule left unmarked at day close counts as broken: it costs 25 XP and leaves you a consequence for the next day. It starts counting the day you mark your first one.

puntosBonus.definicion: What you earn from extra missions. You trade them for rest: 10 PB is one hour, up to 30 PB a week.

campana.definicion: A big goal split into tasks, with loot at the end. Depending on your profile it's called a project, goal, block or subject.

jefe.definicion: A decisive task within a campaign. It gives twice the XP of a normal task of the same difficulty.

botin.definicion: The XP you earn once when you finish a campaign. It ranges from 50 to 600 XP depending on its rank.

coach.definicion: Your AI coach. It prepares your daily plan, reminds you of things and answers your questions; it's part of NIVL Pro.

oraculo.definicion: Tell it a goal and it turns it into missions with a date and a measure. You choose which to accept; it's part of NIVL Pro.

modos.definicion: Arenas for focusing on one part of your life: IRON for gym and diet, FOCUS for study, WORK for work and FOUNDER for your project. A mission with a mode adds to your level and to that mode's.
modos.detalle: NIVL sees everything and is always on. The others are your choice.

elite.definicion: The top plan: the coach at full power, deep mode and a laurel badge. It gives status, not points.
elite.detalle: With Élite you can also ask for a place in a ludus.

ludus.definicion: Your gladiator school: a group of 5 to 8 Élite members with the same goal, measured every week. No chat, just the scoreboard.
